services.name: Helicopter tour
services.desc: The combination of abundant snowfall, cool temperatures and regular breaks in weather systems make British Columbia ideal for heliskiing and snowboarding. Using a helicopter to access vast expanses of terrain in order to ski untracked snow is our speciality. ​​ It is our goal to ensure that no matter which operation you choose to ski or snowboard with, safety is our top priority. Our heliski pilots average 9000 hrs of experience in a variety of different types of operations. blurb: Coldstream Helicopters is a family run business offering efficient and safe helicopter services. They provide solutions for aerial construction, emergency services, heli-skiing, tourism, oil and gas support, orchard protection, and film and TV production. Their fleet includes Airbus AS 332L/L1 Super Puma, Bell 212 HP, and Airbus Astar B2 and B3 helicopters.
